Also, note any documented instances where a "non-traditional character duo" was used during that shortest game, and who the two players were. Verify the "non-traditional character duo" hypothesis for Worlds: Gather evidence that at the 2019 League of Legends World Championship Quarterfinals, G2 Esports used the Garen + Yuumi bot lane against DAMWON Gaming (include game number(s), date, and citations showing the picks). Identify the two G2 players using the duo (AD carry and support) and provide sources. Then confirm that both of those players had transferred into G2 (provide their immediately previous teams and transfer/announcement dates with citations). Finally, provide their birthdates from reliable sources to determine which player is younger. Prioritize authoritative sources such as Liquipedia match pages, LoL Esports VODs/drafts, G2 or Riot announcements, and reputable esports news (Dot Esports, ESPN Esports, Inven Global).

Prioritize sources like Liquipedia/Leaguepedia event or match pages, gol.gg per-game pages, LoL Esports VOD pages, and reputable esports media (Dot Esports, ESPN, Inven Global).
